title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day kills it in advance booking; Tom Holland starrer clocks pre-sales of Rs. 25 crores in India
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has sold 2.60 lakh tickets across India’s top chains and recorded Rs. 25 crore in advance bookings for opening day. Pre-sales could reach Rs. 35 crore with final advances of about 4 lakh tickets, and the film may even post an unprecedented Rs. 50 crore on a working Thursday. Strong demand across national and independent chains positions the film and the MCU for major box-office impact.
content:
The Superhero saga, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, is recording unprecedented advance bookings in India.

The Tom Holland starrer has sold 2.60 lakh tickets across the top three national chains — PVR, Inox and Cinepolis — and with three days still to go is headed to clock advances in the range of 4 lakh tickets.

In gross terms, the superhero film has collected Rs. 25 crore already in advance booking alone for the opening day, and final pre-sales could be as high as Rs. 35 crore. The film has surpassed expectations and is being touted as having a shot at clocking Rs. 50 crore on a working Thursday, a figure that would be unheard of for a Hollywood release in India.

Brand New Day is reinforcing Spider-Man's standing as one of India's most loved superheroes and is helping set up the Marvel Cinematic Universe ahead of its next major installment, Avengers: Doomsday.

Pre-sales are not limited to the national chains; the film has posted spectacular numbers outside those networks as well, indicating widespread demand across regions and exhibitor types.

Industry observers are watching the film's actual release closely: if the content matches the pre-release hype, several box-office records could be challenged or broken. The advance figures have already pushed expectations high and put the spotlight on opening-day performance and weekday holds.
